Title: Odd effect from Immortal Grapple ruling

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
I noticed, while reading through the rulings, under "Immortal Grapple"

*The "only hand strikes" effect lasts for the entire
combat. [TOM 951217]

This has some rather odd consequences. If the inferior version is played,
I can maneuver to long range after the first round. Even with the
superior version, you can maneuver to long range after the second round.

So even at long range, I still cannot use weapons or ranged strikes,
apparently because my opponents arms are still somehow wrapped real tight
around me.

Now thats some kinda immortal grapple. I didn't know that the Potence
discipline gave you powers like Plastic Man.

Lupus Australis
